name: cell-room
title: Chilia rotundă de piatră (înăuntru)
units: engine units (figure 4.2 tall), three.js Y-up, +Z towards the usual camera

center.note: the middle of the room, facing the camera side

pray-a.note: praying spot left, facing the icon

pray-b.note: praying spot right, facing the icon

pray-c.note: a third praying spot, right behind, facing the icon

icon.note: the icon on the back wall (y 3.3 … 5.4)

seat-yellow.note: stand here before sitting down on seat:yellow

seat-red.note: stand here before sitting down on seat:red

seat-green.note: stand here before sitting down on seat:green

table.note: the low table with olives and a cup

door-in.note: inside, before the doorway, facing out (+X)

outside.note: outside the doorway, facing away from it

offstage-out.note: out of sight outside (walk here to leave)

wide.note: the whole round room, the icon, the door on the right

door.note: the doorway and the sunny path outside

notes: Inside of a ROUND stone cell, closed all round: centre [0.0, -2.5], inner radius 7.4 — keep every camera INSIDE (distance from the centre < 6.6) and low (y <= 4.5: the ceiling beams at y 9.3 stay out of the frame). Arched doorway at heading 90 (x = 7.4, z = -2.5), 4.8 wide, straight up to 4.95 + a half-round top, door door:cell (opens outwards like the outside door; it stays open once opened). Icon on the back wall at [0.0, -9.7], bench under it (top 1.59). Cushions (seats): {"yellow": [-4.6, -1.4, 70.0], "red": [-1.6, -3.6, 20.0], "green": [1.6, -3.6, -20.0]}.
